name: OKC_IMP_CONTRACT_HEADERS
description: Interface table for importing Contracts in Fusion.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Import Batch Id, every batch of data  being imported should be assigned a batch id.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a record within a batch, source system should populate this.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of row in the interface table, source system should leave this as null.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Used by import utility to relate the record in interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Code specifying the action for the import for e.g., INSERT, UPDATE or NULL. In the current release only INSERT is supported.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Used internally by the bulk import ODI program.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG_FLAG
columns.description: If Y, this record will be used to populate the _B table. It will also be used to create rows in _TL table forlanguages that are enabled, but have no data in the interface table. If Null, this record will used to populate data in the _TL table for translatable attributes

columns.name: HEADER_ID
columns.description: Primary key of Contract created. Source system should not populate this.

columns.name: CONTRACT_NUMBER
columns.description: Contract Number, identifying the Contract in Fusion. Source system should populate this.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.description: Id of the Business Unit that the Contract belongs to. Maps to FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V. Source system should pass either BU_ID or BU_NAME

columns.name: BU_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Business Unit that the Contract belongs to. Maps to FUN_ALL_BUSINESS_UNITS_V. Source system should pass either BU_ID or BU_NAME

columns.name: CONTRACT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Contract Type Id, Identifies the type of Contract. Source system should pass either CONTRACT_TYPE_ID or CONTRACT_TYPE_NAME.

columns.name: CONTRACT_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Contract Type Name, Identifies the type of Contract. Source system should pass either CONTRACT_TYPE_ID or CONTRACT_TYPE_NAME.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the Contract. Source system should populate this, if not present will be defaulted to current date.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End Date of the Contract, Source system may populate this.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Contract Currency, If not passed by the source system, will be defaulted to the Business Unit's default currency.

columns.name: PRIMARY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Id of the Contract Primary Party.. Source system must pass either PRIMARY_PARTY_ID or PRIMARY_PARTY_NAME.

columns.name: PRIMARY_PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Contract Primary Party. Source system must pass either PRIMARY_PARTY_ID or PRIMARY_PARTY_NAME.

columns.name: CONTRACT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Id of the Contract Owner, corresponds to an Employee or a Salesperson. Source system may pass CONTRACT_OWNER_ID or CONTRACT_OWNER_NAME.

columns.name: CONTRACT_OWNER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Contract Owner, corresponds to an Employee or a Salesperson. Source system may pass CONTRACT_OWNER_ID or CONTRACT_OWNER_NAME. If the Name cannot be resolved uniquely the record will be placed in error.

columns.name: PARTY_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Id of the Prmary Party Contact. Source system may pass PARY_CONTACT_ID or PARTY_CONTACT_NAME.

columns.name: PARTY_CONTACT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Prmary Party Contact. Source system may pass PARY_CONTACT_ID or PARTY_CONTACT_NAME. If the Name cannot be resolved uniquely the record will be placed in error.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Contract Status, Source system should pass this, if not passed will be defaulted to DRAFT

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Contract amount, Source system may pass this. If not passed will be defaulted to 0.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Contract Name, is translatable. Source system may pass this.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE1
columns.description: Source system contract reference, can be used for referring a Contract back to the source system.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: FUSION_CONTRACT_ID
columns.description: For successfully imported Contracts, stores the Fusion Contract Id. This is intended to support reimport.
